content.text: Sign in to make a 3D model. A three.ws account is free. Connect this connector to your three.ws account (OAuth sign-in at https://three.ws/api/mcp-grok?auth=oauth), or create an API key at https://three.ws/dashboard/api-keys and send it as "Authorization: Bearer <key>".
